info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Auto Insurance Quotes Status-v1-spec
info.description: The Auto Insurance Quotes Status API provides real-time updates on the status of submitted auto insurance quotes. This endpoint allows users to check the current state of their quotes to ensure timely processing and informed decision-making. Ideal for insurance agents and customers tracking their applications, this API improves visibility and enhances customer service. Use cases include verifying pending, approved, or rejected quotes efficiently.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of quotes.
get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch the current status of all quotes. It provides insights into the processing or approval state of each quote, enabling efficient tracking and management of quotes in the system.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the status of quotes. It must be formatted as a JSON object conforming to the specified schema, ensuring that all required fields are present.

200.description: The request was successful and returned the current status of the quotes.

ListAutoInsuranceQuotesStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the body of a request to get the status of quotes. The body should be a string that contains relevant information.
